snippet.title: "Loop//Error" - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome to Loop//Error, a dark and atmospheric 2D indie experience that blends bullet hell mechanics, psychological horror, and immersive storytelling. Dive into a twisted world where time loops, memories distort, and reality bends.

Face the unknown. Fight your way through mind-bending challenges. Unravel the error.
